graph_scope: new_owned_theorems_and_definitions; all inherited bodies linked in exact checkpoint

nodes.name: signed_multiplicative_nonempty
nodes.summary: The finite multiplicativity relation excludes an empty positive domain.

nodes.name: signed_multiplicative_table
nodes.summary: Finite multiplicativity includes a genuine arithmetic table, not vacuous missing lookups.

nodes.name: signed_multiplicative_normalized
nodes.summary: The actual value at one is canonical signed positive one, not an arbitrary signed unit.

nodes.name: signed_multiplicative_coprime_product
nodes.summary: Read the exact coprime-product law, including positivity and the inclusive product bound.

nodes.name: signed_multiplicative_intro
nodes.summary: Combine the actual table, positive normalization and bounded coprime law without any hidden premise.

nodes.name: signed_multiplicative_zero_excluded
nodes.summary: No zero-window table satisfies the strict nonempty multiplicativity convention.

nodes.name: signed_multiplicative_at_one_value
nodes.summary: Every actual lookup at one has the unique positive-one signed code 2.

nodes.name: signed_multiplicative_restrict
nodes.summary: The same normalized table is multiplicative on every smaller nonempty positive prefix.

nodes.name: signed_multiplicative_product_values_exist
nodes.summary: Construct all three actual signed values and their multiplication witness; the law is not merely conditional on absent entries.

nodes.name: signed_positive_table_entry_transport
nodes.summary: Transport a real positive lookup across prefix equality by first constructing the target lookup; no encoding or zero-value equality is required.

nodes.name: signed_multiplicative_positive_extensional
nodes.summary: Multiplicativity depends only on the represented positive prefix, not on table codes, zeroth values or entries outside the product bound.

nodes.name: coprime_divisor_gcd_product
nodes.summary: The two genuine gcds multiply to the given positive divisor of a coprime product.

nodes.name: coprime_divisor_factor_pair_coordinates
nodes.summary: Every actual positive factor pair has its coordinates recovered by the two canonical relational gcds.

nodes.name: coprime_divisor_factor_pair_unique
nodes.summary: The positive-divisor product map is injective on genuine divisor pairs of coprime inputs.

nodes.name: coprime_divisor_factor_pair_exists
nodes.summary: Canonical gcd existence supplies real positive divisor coordinates, without a factorization or choice oracle.

nodes.name: coprime_divisor_factor_pair_bounds
nodes.summary: For positive inputs each coordinate lies in its actual divisor window, and the coordinates are coprime.

nodes.name: coprime_divisor_factor_pair_exists_unique
nodes.summary: Every positive divisor of a positive coprime product has exactly one bounded positive divisor pair.

nodes.name: coprime_divisor_factor_pair_cofactors
nodes.summary: Real positive bounded cofactor witnesses have all cross-input coprimality relations and multiply to the true quotient.

nodes.name: divisor_factor_pair_quotient_product
nodes.summary: For any actual positive divisor pair, a supplied product quotient equals the product of the supplied cofactors.

nodes.name: divisor_pair_index_map_append
nodes.summary: Actual bounded quotient and remainder determine the next product value; beta-prefix extension constructs new codes and preserves all earlier decoded entries.

nodes.name: divisor_pair_index_map_exists
nodes.summary: Finite HA induction constructs a native-beta pair-product map for every positive width and finite window, including the empty window.

nodes.name: divisor_pair_index_map_lookup
nodes.summary: At supplied genuine row and bounded column coordinates, the actual beta code stores their product.

nodes.name: divisor_pair_index_map_value
nodes.summary: Any decoded value at a certified coordinate equals the actual coordinate product; equality of beta-code components is not asserted.

nodes.name: signed_slice_identity
nodes.summary: The original packed table itself is a genuine zero-origin, unit-stride slice; the certified endpoint is unused.

nodes.name: signed_slice_sum_unit_prefix_iff
nodes.summary: An actual zero-origin, unit-stride slice sum is exactly the existing actual signed prefix sum, independently of slice encoding.

nodes.name: signed_slice_sum_concatenate
nodes.summary: Ordinary length induction concatenates actual affine sum traces at offset o+s*p, including zero length and zero stride.

nodes.name: signed_slice_sum_concatenate_values
nodes.summary: The two actual consecutive affine sums add to the actual combined sum, without assuming the addition law as a premise.

nodes.name: signed_row_sums_flatten
nodes.summary: Actual row sums concatenate into the genuine flattened source sum by row-count induction, including either zero dimension.

nodes.name: signed_prefix_sum_row_major_iff
nodes.summary: The actual flattened signed prefix and actual row-major rectangle are equivalent, not merely two transposed rectangular folds.

nodes.name: signed_prefix_sum_row_major_exists
nodes.summary: Construct an actual signed value shared by the flattened prefix and its row-major rectangular fold, with no supplied trace or row table.

nodes.name: signed_cartesian_flat_entry_exists
nodes.summary: For positive physical width, actual quotient/remainder and actual signed lookups construct each flattened product value.

nodes.name: signed_cartesian_flat_entry_lookup
nodes.summary: Unique bounded remainder coordinates and signed lookup functionality recover the actual prescribed cell product.

nodes.name: signed_cartesian_flat_prefix_zero
nodes.summary: A real singleton and actual flat product provide the inclusive base prefix.

nodes.name: signed_cartesian_flat_prefix_append
nodes.summary: Actually recode both beta streams, preserve the old represented values, and install the next independently constructed flat product.

nodes.name: signed_cartesian_flat_prefix_exists
nodes.summary: Ordinary induction constructs the entire actual finite flattened product prefix; no finite-choice or output-table oracle is supplied.

nodes.name: signed_cartesian_product_from_flat_prefix
nodes.summary: The actual finite flat construction supplies every in-range row-major product by proved index bounds and unique decoding.

nodes.name: signed_cartesian_product_empty_columns
nodes.summary: A zero-column rectangle has no constrained cell, but all three table packings remain genuine.

nodes.name: signed_cartesian_product_exists
nodes.summary: Construct an actual finite signed outer-product beta table for arbitrary dimensions, explicitly including zero width and zero height.

nodes.name: signed_cartesian_product_row_scalar
nodes.summary: Each actual row slice is a genuine pointwise scalar product by its actual first-input value.

nodes.name: signed_cartesian_product_row_sum
nodes.summary: The actual sum of each product row is the signed product of its row scalar and the actual second-input sum.

nodes.name: signed_cartesian_product_row_sums_scalar
nodes.summary: The genuinely constructed row-sum table is pointwise the first input multiplied by the actual second-input sum.

nodes.name: signed_cartesian_product_rectangular_sum
nodes.summary: Two applications of actual signed scalar linearity prove that the rectangular outer-product total is the product of the two actual sums.

nodes.name: signed_cartesian_product_prefix_sum
nodes.summary: The actual flattened product prefix sums to the canonical signed product, using the separately proved flattening bridge; both zero dimensions are included.

nodes.name: signed_cartesian_product_sums_exists
nodes.summary: Construct the actual outer-product table and all three signed sum traces, and prove their product relation without an assumed constructor or sum witness.

nodes.name: signed_cartesian_quotient_row_bound
nodes.summary: An actual flattened index below a rectangular area has its quotient row below the height, including vacuous zero-area cases.

nodes.name: signed_cartesian_coordinates_exists
nodes.summary: Every actual index in a finite rectangular window has constructed bounded row and column coordinates, with no positive-width assumption supplied.

nodes.name: signed_cartesian_product_flat_lookup
nodes.summary: An actual in-range product-table lookup supplies real bounded coordinates, both actual source values and their genuine signed product.

nodes.name: signed_cartesian_product_extensional_unique
nodes.summary: Every in-range flat index has actual bounded row and column coordinates, so all outer-product encodings represent the same signed value there.

nodes.name: signed_cartesian_product_reencode
nodes.summary: Any real recoding preserving precisely the flattened product window remains the same outer product; the unused endpoint may change.

nodes.name: signed_cartesian_product_exists_extensionally_unique
nodes.summary: Construct the actual outer product and prove value uniqueness on its exact strict finite window, without asserting uniqueness of beta codes.

nodes.name: signed_prefix_sum_single_spike_value
nodes.summary: An actual signed sum with one arbitrary-position entry and proved zero windows has exactly that entry value.

nodes.name: signed_prefix_sum_single_spike_exists
nodes.summary: Construct actual fold traces for an arbitrary-position signed spike, including zero and negative values.

nodes.name: signed_prefix_sum_point_spike_value
nodes.summary: Pointwise zero values away from one actual bounded index imply the two zero windows needed for the spike sum.

nodes.name: signed_support_incidence_entry_hit
nodes.summary: An actual source lookup and actual beta image supply the retained incidence cell.

nodes.name: signed_support_incidence_entry_miss
nodes.summary: An actual source lookup and beta image construct a zero cell at every different target index.

nodes.name: signed_support_incidence_entry_decode
nodes.summary: Actual signed lookup and beta uniqueness recover the independently stated hit-or-zero cell cases.

nodes.name: signed_support_incidence_entry_functional
nodes.summary: The actual incidence value is unique, independent of witnesses and component representations.

nodes.name: signed_support_incidence_entry_exists
nodes.summary: Every cell is constructively computed from a real signed lookup, a real natural beta image, and decidable equality.

nodes.name: signed_support_incidence_zero_source_value
nodes.summary: Every incidence cell of a represented zero source is zero, even at an out-of-window image.

nodes.name: signed_support_incidence_nonzero_source_image
nodes.summary: A nonzero incidence value witnesses both the identical actual source value and the actual beta image.

nodes.name: signed_support_incidence_flat_entry_exists
nodes.summary: Division by the positive padded width S M and actual incidence lookup construct every flat value, including M=0.

nodes.name: signed_support_incidence_flat_entry_coordinates
nodes.summary: Uniqueness of actual quotient and strict remainder recovers the specified incidence coordinates.

nodes.name: signed_support_incidence_flat_prefix_zero
nodes.summary: A real singleton encodes the first actual flat incidence cell.

nodes.name: signed_support_incidence_flat_prefix_append
nodes.summary: Constructively append one actual flat cell and preserve every preceding represented value.

nodes.name: signed_support_incidence_flat_prefix_exists
nodes.summary: Ordinary induction constructs the entire inclusive prefix by real beta-stream extension, with no choice or sum oracle.

nodes.name: signed_support_incidence_from_flat_prefix
nodes.summary: The genuine inclusive flat prefix covers every strict rectangular cell; the extra column and endpoint are unused.

nodes.name: signed_support_incidence_exists
nodes.summary: Construct an actual padded incidence table for every pair of finite dimensions, including either zero dimension.

nodes.name: signed_support_incidence_row_lookup
nodes.summary: An actual affine row-slice entry is the incidence cell at the same strict row and column indices.

nodes.name: signed_support_incidence_column_lookup
nodes.summary: An actual affine column-slice entry is the same incidence cell after proved natural index commutation.

nodes.name: signed_support_incidence_row_sum_value
nodes.summary: Each actual incidence row is zero or one genuinely bounded spike, so its actual sum is the actual source value.

nodes.name: signed_support_incidence_column_sum_value
nodes.summary: Target coverage supplies the actual nonzero spike; active injectivity excludes other nonzero cells and preservation handles zero targets.

nodes.name: signed_support_incidence_row_sums_equal
nodes.summary: Every actual incidence row-sum table agrees with the represented source values on precisely the strict source window.

nodes.name: signed_support_incidence_column_sums_equal
nodes.summary: Every actual incidence column-sum table agrees with the represented target values on precisely the strict target window.

nodes.name: signed_support_reindex_sum_equal
nodes.summary: Construct the actual incidence and both fold tables; ordinary finite Fubini proves equality under support-only reindexing, including unequal or empty windows.

nodes.name: signed_support_reindex_sum_exists
nodes.summary: Actually construct both signed finite folds and their common canonical value; neither fold is assumed as an oracle.

nodes.name: signed_mul_four_factor_interchange
nodes.summary: Reorder four actual signed factors by constructing the intermediate product and using checked associativity and commutativity.

nodes.name: signed_mul_nonzero_factors
nodes.summary: A nonzero actual signed product has two nonzero factors, by the signed zero laws and functionality.

nodes.name: dirichlet_convolution_entry_nonzero_support
nodes.summary: A genuinely nonzero convolution summand supplies a positive divisor and its actual quotient; omitted indices cannot enter the support.

nodes.name: dirichlet_multiplicative_pair_factorization
nodes.summary: On a genuine coprime divisor pair, construct positive cofactors and six signed lookups, apply both bounded multiplicative laws, and factor the actual target summand.

nodes.name: dirichlet_multiplicative_pair_entry
nodes.summary: The product of the two actual pair summands is a genuine target convolution entry; its value is identified using a constructed target entry, never assumed.

nodes.name: dirichlet_coprime_grid_nonzero_coordinates
nodes.summary: Every genuinely nonzero product-table entry decodes to a positive divisor pair and two actual nonzero convolution summands; zero and nondivisor collisions are excluded constructively.

nodes.name: dirichlet_coprime_grid_support_preserving
nodes.summary: Each nonzero source slot has its actual beta image in the shorter target window and exactly the same signed value, by proved summand factorization.

nodes.name: dirichlet_coprime_grid_support_injective
nodes.summary: Equal beta images of two genuinely nonzero source slots give the same positive divisor pair by gcd uniqueness, hence the same flattened index; inactive collisions remain permitted.

nodes.name: dirichlet_coprime_grid_support_covering
nodes.summary: Every nonzero target summand has a genuine bounded source slot: construct its unique positive divisor pair, both input summands and the product-table lookup, then prove exact value preservation.

nodes.name: dirichlet_coprime_grid_support_reindex
nodes.summary: The actual native-beta divisor-product map is a value-preserving bijection of nonzero support between two unequal finite windows; no whole-window permutation is asserted.

nodes.name: dirichlet_coprime_product_data_construct
nodes.summary: From the actual three summand prefixes construct the Cartesian product table and native-beta index map, with no assumed table, map, sum or reindexing conclusion.

nodes.name: dirichlet_convolution_multiplicative_values
nodes.summary: The actual convolution values at positive coprime m,n multiply to the actual value at mn, using genuine divisor-pair support reindexing and only in-prefix multiplicativity.

nodes.name: dirichlet_convolution_multiplicative_table
nodes.summary: An actual convolution table of two normalized multiplicative signed prefixes is itself normalized and multiplicative on every positive coprime product through the inclusive bound.

nodes.name: dirichlet_convolution_multiplicative_exists_unique
nodes.summary: Construct a genuine multiplicative convolution table and prove uniqueness of its represented positive values, without identifying arbitrary zero values or table encodings.

nodes.name: dirichlet_multiplicative_function_invertible
nodes.summary: Positive-one normalization gives an actual two-sided finite Dirichlet inverse with any prescribed zeroth value; this corollary does not assert multiplicativity of the inverse.

nodes.name: Le
nodes.summary: Witness-defined non-strict order on natural numbers.

nodes.name: Lt
nodes.summary: Witness-defined strict order on natural numbers.

nodes.name: Dvd
nodes.summary: The natural number d divides n.

nodes.name: Coprime
nodes.summary: Every common divisor of a and b is one.

nodes.name: IsGCD
nodes.summary: g is a common divisor divisible by every common divisor.

nodes.name: DivRem
nodes.summary: q and r are a quotient and a strict remainder for n by d.

nodes.name: BetaAt
nodes.summary: x is the bounded beta-decoded value at index i.

nodes.name: MatrixMinorFourCode
nodes.summary: One canonical injective doubled-Cantor code for all four signed-minor beta-code parameters.

nodes.name: SignedDecode
nodes.summary: The original canonical integer code: even 2p denotes p, and odd 2k+1 denotes −(k+1). The decoded positive and negative parts are normalized.

nodes.name: SignedBalance
nodes.summary: The original canonical code z represents the integer difference p−n; these supplied components need not be normalized.

nodes.name: ArithAt
nodes.summary: Two genuine beta entries of the packed table represent the unique canonical signed value z. Distinct component representations need not be equal.

nodes.name: ArithTableEqual
nodes.summary: Pointwise equality of actual canonical signed lookups below l, not equality of table codes or their positive/negative components.

nodes.name: ArithPositiveEqual
nodes.summary: Equality of represented values at precisely 0<d<=N. Values at zero are unrestricted, and raw codes or positive/negative representatives are not asserted equal.

nodes.name: ArithTable
nodes.summary: An actual packed signed table with canonical signed entries through index N, including index zero. It contains no divisor transform or inversion hypothesis.

nodes.name: SignedMul
nodes.summary: Actual multiplication of original canonical signed codes; opposite-sign products remain on the negative side of the balance.

nodes.name: ArithScale
nodes.summary: Actual source and output tables with witnessed multiplication of every represented entry below l by the signed scalar a. Sum distributivity is a separate theorem.

nodes.name: SignedAdd
nodes.summary: Actual addition of original canonical signed codes, witnessed by their decoders and balanced equality.

nodes.name: Sum
nodes.summary: z is the sum of a beta-coded prefix of length l.

nodes.name: SignedPrefixSum
nodes.summary: The signed balance of two actual natural finite sums, at exactly the indices 0<=i<l. Existence, uniqueness and representation independence are proved separately.

nodes.name: ArithSlice
nodes.summary: Actual signed tables with witnessed values G(i)=F(o+s*i) for i<l. The output is constructed by real beta-stream recoding; its separately certified endpoint is unused.

nodes.name: SignedSliceSum
nodes.summary: An actually constructed affine slice followed by its genuine signed prefix sum. Both zero length and zero stride are meaningful; no sum oracle is part of the graph.

nodes.name: ArithRowSums
nodes.summary: An actual row table R contains, at i<m, the signed sum of the n entries F((o+s*i)+t*j). Source and row-table packings are explicit, including empty dimensions.

nodes.name: SignedRectangularSum
nodes.summary: Construct an actual row-sum table and take its actual m-entry signed sum. Equality after swapping strides and dimensions is the independently proved finite Fubini theorem.

nodes.name: SignedZeroWindow
nodes.summary: Every actual signed lookup on the half-open interval k<=i<l has value zero. Table validity, existence of folds, and equality after padding are separate hypotheses or theorems, not part of this graph.

nodes.name: DirichletEntry
nodes.summary: At a positive divisor d, witness n=d*q, read the actual signed values F(d) and G(q), and multiply them. Zero and nondivisors contribute canonical zero without reading either input at zero. Source-table validity is separate.

nodes.name: DirichletPrefix
nodes.summary: An actual signed table M records the independently defined convolution entry at every inclusive index 0<=d<=l. The endpoint l is included and can differ from n; no sum or convolution identity is assumed.

nodes.name: DirichletSum
nodes.summary: Require n>0, construct a real convolution-summand prefix through n, and take its actual signed fold over exactly S n entries. Zero is outside this sum's input domain; no value is assigned by a unit or inversion formula.

nodes.name: DirichletTable
nodes.summary: Three actual finite signed tables whose output H(n), at every 0<n<=N, is the independently defined convolution sum of F and G. All zero entries are unrestricted; only represented positive values, not table codes, are subsequently proved unique.

nodes.name: KroneckerDeltaTable
nodes.summary: An actual signed table has code 2 at n=1 and code 0 at all other positive n<=N. Its zero entry is unrestricted and N=0 has an empty positive domain. Both convolution unit laws are theorems, not definition premises.

nodes.name: DirichletInverse
nodes.summary: Witness a real Kronecker delta table E and both actual convolution tables F*G=E and G*F=E on 0<n<=N. Their graphs include actual table validity; values at zero remain unrestricted. The unit-at-one criterion is not a definition premise, and its necessity requires N>0; zero-window inverse identities are separately proved for all actual input tables.

nodes.name: DirichletUnitAtOne
nodes.summary: An actual lookup F(1) has canonical signed code 2 or 1. This direct disjunction contains ArithAt, not a SignedUnit or inverse subformula. Table validity, the finite window bound, and the inverse criterion are separate hypotheses or theorems.

nodes.name: MultiplicativePrefix
nodes.summary: An actual nonempty signed prefix, N>0, has F(1)=+1 (canonical code 2) and the signed product law for positive coprime a,b with a*b<=N. F(0) and values outside that window remain unrestricted. Signed-unit codes plus or minus one are not this normalization; the one-argument planning notation Multiplicative(f) is not an alias.

nodes.name: DivisorFactorPair
nodes.summary: Actual positive a,b divide m,n respectively and d=a*b. Coprimality of m,n, coordinate bounds, gcd recovery, existence and uniqueness are separate hypotheses or proved consequences, not clauses of this relation.

nodes.name: DivisorPairIndexMap
nodes.summary: Positive width V and native beta codes record d*e whenever i<L, e<V and i=V*d+e. L may be zero. No row bound, target bound, injectivity, signed value or sum identity is assumed; inactive images may collide.

nodes.name: SignedCartesianProduct
nodes.summary: Actual signed tables satisfy T[n*i+j]=F[i]*G[j] for i<m and j<n, with the genuine signed multiplication graph. Zero dimensions are allowed. T separately certifies its unused endpoint m*n; no product-of-sums or flattening identity is a definition premise.

nodes.name: SignedSupportReindex
nodes.summary: Actual tables and a native beta map preserve nonzero source values at bounded target indices, are injective only on nonzero source support, and cover every nonzero target value. Unequal or empty windows and inactive collisions are allowed. This is not a whole-window permutation and contains no sum equality.

nodes.name: SignedIncidenceEntry
nodes.summary: Read the actual signed source value at i and its actual native beta image. The cell equals that value when j is the image and equals zero otherwise. No reindexing, table-construction or sum conclusion is assumed.

nodes.name: SignedIncidenceFlatEntry
nodes.summary: Witness actual quotient/remainder coordinates k=(S M)*i+j with j<S M, then read the independently defined incidence cell. Physical stride S M remains positive when M=0; this graph has no upper row bound.

nodes.name: SignedIncidenceFlatPrefix
nodes.summary: An actual signed table T stores incidence flat entries at every inclusive index k<=l. Its construction by genuine finite beta-prefix extension and its later finite-fold properties are separate theorems.

nodes.name: SignedSupportIncidence
nodes.summary: An actual signed incidence table uses physical stride S M and cells i<L,j<M. T is valid through L*(S M); the padding column j=M and final endpoint are unused. The source is an actual table, but no target, support bijection or Fubini equality is part of this graph.

nodes.name: DirichletCoprimeProductData
nodes.summary: Two normalized multiplicative prefixes, positive coprime m,n with m*n<=N, three actual convolution-entry prefixes, an actual Cartesian product table and a native beta coordinate-product map. Neither the support reindexing conclusion nor any signed sum or multiplicativity result is built into this data.

nodes.name: DirichletDivisorGridWitness
nodes.summary: Actual bounded positive divisor coordinates d,e have i=(S n)*d+e, independently defined Dirichlet summands a,b and SignedMul(a,b,z). The signed values a,b,z need not be nonzero. No factorization oracle, target summand or convolution closure is assumed.
